title: C08 source rights
description: What a source's own owner permits for it, whatever layer references it: read, use, derive, export. Reading alone permits no derivation and no export, and no Team grant or policy reaches past this ceiling; an action beyond it is `source_right_not_overridable`. A derivative carries its bases' rights by digest and permits nothing a base does not; that relates this record to another, so the runtime owner keeps it and P01's cases check it. Setting rights is a commit to the source itself: `source.rights.set` expects the source's current head and moves it, so a revision sealed before the rights changed is stale. The owner is the actor of the request; the runtime writes it and the time.

carries.description: For a derivative: each base source and the digest of its rights.
